tagline: An old town in a valley with pretty temples, good coffee, and mountain roads up to the morning mist
introHtml: Nan is a northern town in a valley that you can wander around all day without getting bored. In town there are old temples like Wat Phumin, with its famous Pu Man Ya Man mural worth a stop, and small streets packed with cafes and northern Thai restaurants. Outside town, the roads climb the mountains toward Pua and Bo Kluea, passing terraced rice fields, seas of mist, and the still-living Tai Lue way of life. If you like slow towns and easy road trips, Nan is a province you can settle into for several unhurried days.
bestTime: November to February, cool and clear skies, great for heading up the mountains to see the sea of mist

highlights.name: Wat Phumin
highlights.blurb: A cruciform temple in the heart of town with the Pu Man Ya Man mural, the famous whispering lovers, the image most people picture when they think of Nan

highlights.name: Kad Khuang Mueang Nan Walking Street
highlights.blurb: Opens in the evening in front of Wat Phumin, with local food, khantoke meals, and an old-town atmosphere for a long stroll

highlights.name: Pua District
highlights.blurb: A small town amid the rice fields with the Tai Lue way of life, coffee shops over the paddies, Tai Lue temples, and the road up Doi Phu Kha

highlights.name: Bo Kluea
highlights.blurb: A village that still boils salt from mountain rock-salt wells the old way, a craft unique to Nan

highlights.name: Doi Samer Dao - Pha Chu, Sri Nan
highlights.blurb: A camping spot to watch the sea of mist and the sunrise over the Nan River, with wide-open views morning and evening

highlights.name: Sky Road 1256, Pua - Bo Kluea
highlights.blurb: A drive along the ridgeline with layers of mountains on both sides, the highlight of any Nan road trip

foodScene.name: Northern Thai food
foodScene.note: Khao soi, nam ngiao, kaeng hang le, and northern larb are easy to find all over town, bold flavors the way northerners like it

foodScene.name: Nan khao soi
foodScene.note: Several long-running khao soi shops in town, soft noodles in a rich curry broth, eaten with pickled greens and shallots

foodScene.name: Sai ua, kaep mu, nam phrik
foodScene.note: Northern dishes to go with sticky rice, and you can buy them to take home too

foodScene.name: Tai Lue food
foodScene.note: Around Pua and Thung Chang there are Tai Lue communities with their own nam phrik and local vegetable dishes

foodScene.name: Nan cafes and coffee
foodScene.note: Nan grows arabica coffee up in the hills, and both in town and in Pua plenty of cafes look out over the paddies and mountains

foodScene.name: Ma fai chin drinks
foodScene.note: Ma fai chin (wampee) is a fruit Nan is known for, sold fresh, as juice, and made into souvenirs

foodScene.name: Morning market - Nan fresh market
foodScene.note: The morning market has sticky rice, nam phrik, local vegetables, and regional sweets to graze on

foodScene.name: Local sweets
foodScene.note: Khao kaep, khao khuap, and nam ngiao noodles are breakfast staples that people in Nan eat regularly

attractions.name: Wat Phumin
attractions.blurb: A cruciform temple in the center of town with the famous Pu Man Ya Man mural, a must-stop when you come to Nan

attractions.name: Wat Phra That Chae Haeng
attractions.blurb: Nan's guardian stupa, a golden chedi on a rise visible from afar, the year-of-the-rabbit shrine

attractions.name: Nan National Museum
attractions.blurb: An old palace building in the center of town, home to the black ivory tusk and the story of Nan, with a frangipani archway out front that photographs well

attractions.name: Doi Phu Kha National Park
attractions.blurb: A high mountain along the Pua route, with chomphu phu kha trees, montane forest, and several sea-of-mist viewpoints

attractions.name: Doi Samer Dao
attractions.blurb: A camping spot in Sri Nan National Park to watch the sea of mist and the sunrise over the Nan River

attractions.name: Bo Kluea rock-salt wells
attractions.blurb: The Bo Kluea village still boils salt from mountain brine the old way, where you can see the process and buy salt to take home

attractions.name: Sao Din Na Noi - Khok Suea
attractions.blurb: Eroded earth pillars in striking shapes in Na Noi district, good for a walk and photos

attractions.name: Wat Sri Mongkhon (Kong), Pua
attractions.blurb: A temple in Pua whose back terrace looks out over terraced rice fields and the Doi Phu Kha range, a popular photo spot
